title_en: SNU Commons Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series: First Lecture
summary: All members of the university community, including students and faculty and staff, are invited to attend the first lecture of the SNU Commons Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series. The lecture will take place on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 11:30 in the Lecture Hall on the first floor of the SNU Commons Administration Building. Those wishing to attend should apply through the SNU extracurricular programme website (SNU 비교과 사이트).
applies_to: All members of the university community (students, faculty, staff and others). Attendance is optional.

dates.what: First lecture of the SNU Commons Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series

conditions: The commemorative gift and lunch (sandwich) are given only to those who attend on the day of the event.
Attendance requires applying through the SNU extracurricular programme website (SNU 비교과 사이트).
steps: Read this notice; note that the attached poster image was not read and its content is not included here.
Apply through the SNU extracurricular programme website (SNU 비교과 사이트) using the participation link given in the original notice.
Attend the lecture on Friday, 20 November 2026 at 11:30 in the Lecture Hall, 1st floor, SNU Commons Administration Building (행정관), to receive the commemorative gift and lunch.
translation:
Announcement: "SNU Commons (Special) Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series" Event

A. Event: "SNU Commons (Special) Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series", Lecture No. 1

B. Speaker: a Distinguished Chair Professor (특임석좌교수) of the Department of Sociology, College of Social Sciences (the speaker's name is given in the original notice)

C. Date and time: Friday, 20 November 2026, 11:30

D. Venue: Lecture Hall, 1st floor, SNU Commons Administration Building (행정관)

E. Eligible participants: All members of the university community (students, faculty, staff, etc.)

F. How to apply: Apply through the SNU extracurricular programme website (SNU 비교과 사이트).

※ A commemorative gift and lunch (sandwich) will be provided only to those who attend on the day of the event: participation application link (the link is in the original notice).

※ Next lecture (No. 2): a Distinguished Chair Professor (특임석좌교수) of the Department of Agricultural Biotechnology, College of Agriculture and Life Sciences (the speaker's name is given in the original notice). No date is stated for the next lecture.

Attachment (1 file): "SNU Commons (Special) Distinguished Chair Professor Lecture Series" poster.jpg (7 MB). This image was not read, and its content is not included in this translation.
